meta.title: Christmas Word Search: Hidden Messages & Festive Facts
meta.author: Nell Bramley

content: Every puzzle stands on its own, so open the book wherever you like.
Spaces are left out of the grid, so RED RIBBON hides as REDRIBBON.
Each word is there exactly once, and words may cross and share a letter.
Loop each word in the grid, then cross it off the list.
A small key above each word list shows which ways the words run. The
book starts gently and adds directions as it goes:

content: Half the puzzles end with a festive fact. The other half hide a message:
once every word is found, the letters left over spell it out. Read the rows
from the top, each from left to right, and write the letters on the blanks.
The blanks are spaced into words; punctuation is left out.
, and every puzzle page tells you where to

The season starts at the front door and works
its way in: a wreath, a stocking on the mantel,
a bed made up for someone still on the road.
